name: Pina Colada Dip
description: A creamy and tropical dip made with pineapple, coconut pudding, and sour cream, perfect for serving with fresh fruit.
recipeIngredient: 3½ oz package instant coconut pudding and pie filling (or 1 vanilla pudding and ¼ cup shredded coconut with coconut extract)

recipeInstructions.text: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor or blender until smooth.
Refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled with a variety of fresh fruits.

keywords: pina colada dip, fruit dip, coconut pudding, party appetizer

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Orange-Pineapple Jello
_similar.description: A fruity Jello dessert with orange, pineapple, and nuts.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup frozen orange juice concentrate

recipeInstructions.text: Drain pineapple and reserve syrup. Add water to make ¾ cup.
Heat the liquid to boiling.
Place Jello in a bowl and add hot liquid, pineapple, and orange juice concentrate.
Chill until thickish.
Fold in Dream Whip along with marshmallows and pecans.

_similar.name: Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful cream cheese dip infused with orange juice and marshmallow creme, ideal for fresh fruit.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a dish and beat until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with fresh cut-up fruit.

_similar.keywords: fruit dip, orange cream cheese, marshmallow dip

_similar.name: Party-Time Salad
_similar.description: A creamy lime Jello salad with pineapple, cream cheese, and celery.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat pineapple juice and hot water to measure 1 cup.
Dissolve Jello powder in hot liquid and stir, then add ¾ cup cold water.
Let partially set.
Add cream cheese and mix with beaters.
Add crushed pineapple, whipped cream, and celery.
Pour into a 1½ quart mould and chill until firm.

_similar.keywords: party-time salad, lime Jello, cream cheese, pineapple

_similar.name: Fluffy Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A light and airy fruit dip made with softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.

recipeInstructions.text: In a bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.
Mix until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with your choice of fresh fruit.

_similar.keywords: fluffy fruit dip, marshmallow dip, sweet appetizer
